name: Vietnam
summary: Southeast Asian coastal nation along the Red River and Mekong deltas. Rapidly added rooftop solar and hydroelectric generation while coping with seasonal Red River delta particulate haze.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 5.16x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); agricultural residue burning and motorcycle exhaust elevate Hanoi winter levels.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; rising sea levels and salinity intrusion affect the low-lying Mekong delta.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Tropical monsoon warming trend rate over 1994-2023 trailing three decades.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.9% share of global fossil emissions; expanding rapid manufacturing export economy.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Below world average per capita rate; industrial energy efficiency being introduced under PDP8 power plan.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Contains ~148,000 km² of tropical monsoon and mangrove forests following successful national reforestation.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Clean energy success: hydropower (28.4%) paired with world-record deployment of rooftop solar PV (12.2%).

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 315 people/km²; urban population fraction is 39.5%.
